evidence.title: Medical company announces program for 'AI-powered prescriptions' in Utah

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health corporate registration and company records
occurrences.quote_span: Editor's note: This story has been corrected to clarify that Nolla Health is based in New York City.
occurrences.speaker: ABC News
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health pilot schedule and stage-duration records
occurrences.quote_span: The company said stages one and two would last at least four and eight weeks, respectively.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health stage-transition criteria and Utah state approval records
occurrences.quote_span: "Moving to the next stage requires meeting safety targets, including 95% agreement with physicians and zero serious adverse events, and written approval from the state," the post said.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health announcement blog post
occurrences.quote_span: Nolla Health, which is based in New York City, introduced the program in a blog post announcing the "AI-powered prescriptions," its acne treatment prescription process, which will roll out in three stages.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Clinical literature on acne treatment and Nolla Health's technology rationale
occurrences.quote_span: The company said acne treatment was a viable starting point for the technology because it is "well understood, low risk, and backed by decades of clinical evidence."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Derm pricing and prescription-service terms
occurrences.quote_span: The company said the Nolla Derm application "will prescribe effective acne treatment from $4.99 a month" and require "no office visit."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Derm app availability and pricing records
occurrences.quote_span: The post said Utah residents 18 and older can download the app and begin the process at a discounted rate of $4.99 per month.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health stage-one pilot protocol and physician review logs
occurrences.quote_span: In the first stage, which includes the first 100 patients, "two licensed physicians independently review and approve every AI-generated prescription before it reaches the patient."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health escalation and adverse-effect review records
occurrences.quote_span: A physician will also review "every case involving an escalation or a side effect."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy authorization records
occurrences.quote_span: The company said the pilot is the first in the U.S. authorized by a state regulator to allow AI to issue initial prescriptions, and that it was authorized after working with the Utah Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health stage-two pilot protocol and physician review logs
occurrences.quote_span: In the second stage, which will include up to 500 patients, "Nolla Derm issues prescriptions directly, and a physician reviews every case after the fact, at least weekly."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health pilot rollout plan
occurrences.quote_span: The pilot will roll out in three stages with physician involvement in each, according to the company.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Derm app workflow and prescription-generation records
occurrences.quote_span: "In about 10--15 minutes, this generates a personalized treatment plan and, if appropriate, an initial prescription," the post said.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health stage-three physician review protocol and audit records
occurrences.quote_span: In the third stage of the pilot, a 10% sample of prescriptions each month will be reviewed by a physician.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Derm patient intake and app workflow
occurrences.quote_span: After verifying their identity, providing informed consent and filling out an intake questionnaire, patients take a "quick five-angle face scan."
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah state authorization for the Nolla Health pilot program
occurrences.quote_span: A health care company announced Monday that it has received authorization for a pilot program in Utah allowing artificial intelligence to issue initial prescriptions, including acne treatment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot

occurrences.checkable_against: Nolla Health pilot program description
occurrences.quote_span: The company says the program is designed to close "the access gap" to healthcare, in this case, by avoiding the appointment wait times and costs associated with visiting a dermatologist.
occurrences.speaker: Nolla Health
occurrences.subject: Nolla Health AI-powered prescriptions pilot
